law_lock.bare_step: k=0 only, original Eq0.17; later Eq0.19/2.12 includes the preceding effective action and is not covered by this bare factor list
law_lock.soft_gauge_coefficient: Eq0.17 gives the same g0^(-2) coefficient for the soft contour action and Wilson action. The alpha in Eq0.14 is not an independently adjustable gap parameter in this fixed first-step law.
law_lock.cutoff: Keep the exact original free-coordinate product cutoff and its already fixed threshold/norm. Eq2.9 gives its structure; this reading does not equate its two cutoff options with a selected CMP116 threshold or resolve the historical fixed-constant discrepancy.
law_lock.normalization: Keep N0 from the same integral at V=1 and the fixed1513 Gaussian/delta/baseline allocation. No reciprocal probability or independent-volume normalizer is supplied.

coordinate_dictionary.source_Q: linearized coarse averaging constraint, not precision
coordinate_dictionary.source_C: linear selected reconstruction from free to all bond variables, not the Gaussian covariance
coordinate_dictionary.source_A0: classical quadratic form after the physical critical cancellation, including the source current/constraint correction
coordinate_dictionary.ours_Qfree: R_rec^* A0 R_rec, with R_rec=source C; Gaussian covariance is Qfree^(-1), as source printed268 states
coordinate_dictionary.conditioning_warning: If using a restricted domain D, first identify its actual fixed free-coordinate precision. An ambient principal block of A0 or a separately reconstructed local operator is not automatically that precision; keep induced exterior/conditional means.

factor_families.carrier: Original four-link plaquette after the actual two-block selected reconstruction
factor_families.allocation: Subtract carrierwise classical Taylor constants/linear/quadratic pieces consistently; their full linear sum vanishes only at the actual constrained critical point. Sum of quadratics is the actual Gaussian precision, not an extra interaction.

factor_families.carrier: Original root-to-site contour/group mean within one block, with all source contours retained
factor_families.allocation: Use Eq0.17 coefficient g0^(-2), retain the exact group-mean convention and complete physical quadratic.

factor_families.family: Haar logarithms on free and selected bonds
factor_families.carrier: One free bond, or the original endpoint-block union for a selected output
factor_families.allocation: Keep every nonconstant term, including any linear contribution. Allocate only the already declared constants to the baseline; do not discard logarithmic density terms as critical action terms.

factor_families.carrier: One finite selected Lie block per coarse bond under the exact1546 per-c locality convention
factor_families.allocation: Its log is separate from the constant linear delta-elimination determinant. Neither is counted twice or replaced by an uncontrolled global determinant.

factor_families.carrier: The r_g scalar coordinates of one distinct FREE Lie-valued bond
factor_families.allocation: zeta_b=-1_(K_b complement), so product_b(1+zeta_b)=1_K exactly. Selected outputs are not extra independent cutoff labels; their chart/source restrictions remain explicit admission conditions.

combined_support_budget.premise: The exact original interaction carriers have scalar size <=D_int and scalar incidence <=m_int as conditionally counted in1564; source orientations/anchor convention must match that original list.
combined_support_budget.combined_m: m_int+1: each free scalar coordinate belongs to exactly one original cutoff-bond tail
combined_support_budget.overlap_Delta_upper: D*(m-1), a conservative union bound for the original-label overlap graph; no bounded-size assumption on an overlap component
combined_support_budget.conditional1564_count: If its stated fixed-L,d,r and positive-original-label convention is admitted: D_int=3^d*d*(L+2)^d*r and m_int=3^d*p with p=[d(d-1)/2+d+1]*L^d+d. This is not an independent source-constant certificate.

mixed_norm_binding.covariance_upper_role: C_Gauss<=a_Q^(-1) I, where a_Q is a lower bound for the ACTUAL Qfree; it is not the B role in density derivatives
mixed_norm_binding.fourth_moment_epsilon: epsilon=a_Q/(32*m), t0<=epsilon; using combined m is conservative
mixed_norm_binding.original_tail_q: 2^(r_g/2)*exp(-a_Q*kappa^2*rho^2/4), with the original norm-equivalence kappa and original rho
mixed_norm_binding.all_subsets_bound: ||product interaction f_i product distinct tail zeta_b||_2 <=(K4*t0)^n*q^(h/4), from the determinant moment and Cauchy-Schwarz; no independence of coordinates or tail events
mixed_norm_binding.remaining_uniformity: Actual common chart, t0 domination, a_Q and every fixed source/norm constant must be uniform on the stated physical family. The formula does not verify those premises.

link_budget_binding.density_B: B_Q from the actual upper precision bound, since C_Gauss>=B_Q^(-1)I
link_budget_binding.scalar_J: A separate actual absolute scalar covariance row sum;1540 offers a conditional weighted-Schur route with its extra finite-range/geometry/gap premises. Never infer J from spectral positivity alone.
link_budget_binding.criterion: For eta>0 and requested theta>=0, lambda*exp(eta+theta)<=min(1/(2*A*R),eta/((Delta+1)*(1+A*log2))), A=e*sqrt6, is only a sufficient declared-input window. Actual source satisfaction is still to be proved.

hypothesis_reduction: The bare source supplies the interaction families and absence of an older E term; the original free product cutoff then fixes its tail-label incidence with no extra unspecified tail multiplicity. This binds previously separate input roles without admitting the whole physical family.
retained_gates: Exact original cutoff version and source norm constants
Actual critical/off-shell/current/frame dictionary and full pulled-back Qfree
Uniform a_Q,B_Q and weighted scalar J for the same source family
Uniform original local t0/all-subsets norm and common chart
Original maximal/variational hierarchy versus auxiliary localized domains
Correct baseline/normalizer and physical marked marginal/history transport
falsifiers: A selected solve involving another coarse selected interface invalidates the per-c carrier/Jacobian budget
Any omitted effective/nonlocal density term or residual independent indicator requires enlarging the actual factor inventory, not deleting it
A reconstruction changing free coordinates would defeat the claimed original cutoff identity
Growth of actual D,m,a_Q^(-1),B_Q,J or remainder constants can destroy the joint window even when t0 or q separately tends to zero
Dropping logarithmic linear terms or adjusting soft alpha/cutoff constants would change the fixed law
